title: pinguicula macroceras var. microceras
intro: Pinguicula macroceras var. microceras, commonly known as Butterwort or Mexican Butterwort, is a carnivorous plant species native to Mexico. It is known for its unique ability to obtain essential nutrients by capturing and digesting insects. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including the reduction of inflammation, improvement of respiratory problems, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pinguicula macroceras var. microceras include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
